summary_1line: Krishna departs the Pandavas and returns to Dwaraka; Maya Danava promises Arjuna to fetch gems and weapons to build the Pandavas’ magnificent future palace.

image_candidates.scene_text: Krishna stands on a golden chariot with a Garuda banner while the five Pandava brothers surround and honor him before his departure.
Yudhishthira holds Krishna’s reins while Arjuna fans him with a white chamara as the Pandavas escort him from the city.
Maya Danava speaks to Arjuna about the jeweled peak near Kailasa and the treasure-filled lake Vindu beneath glittering mountains.
